summary: Director, Investment Risk candidate with ~7 years across multi-asset institutional investment-risk analytics — VaR / CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition and attribution, scenario and stress testing, and stochastic Monte Carlo modelling. Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement at Moody's Analytics; LDI and long-horizon scenario depth from Ortec Finance pension mandates. CFA charter, dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering), Python-advanced.

sections.heading: Investment Risk Measurement & Oversight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn+ of institutional assets across the book.
Independently review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions; escalate outputs lacking economic defensibility to Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Scenario Analysis, Stress Testing & Cash-Flow Projection
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across short- and long-horizon investment views.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding decisions, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation analysis.
Embedded behavioral assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into scenario outputs feeding portfolio-level risk reporting.

sections.heading: Analytics Engineering & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded validation controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time on comparable modules by an estimated 30–40%.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities — translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe multi-asset analytics platform.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners; advised on asset, liability, and portfolio configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning risk and accounting frameworks with system implementation.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program teams on adoption and governance documentation; contributed to regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, risk attribution, contribution-to-risk, risk-budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators to assess interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Delivered ALM and LDI studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors; advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency exposures; modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types.

Presented findings at client on-site meetings, including discussions with pension-fund investment committees; led the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) JSPP merger of three university plans.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
